scientific_purpose: Test using four SHA-pinned source-trained LATFUSE008 original FP32 models on genuine original May2014 observed high/ordinary PM2.5 event pairs if the genuine historic-event BCE gradient can traverse 16,64,128,512 recorded source hourly transitions to the event-time associative matrix or only recent fast/slow representations. No optimizer/model tuning or exposed/protected source values.
source_cohort: Use deterministic first four genuine source pairs (8 real high/ordinary original PM2.5 anchors) of the frozen May1-Jun10 2014 LATFUSE008 registered internal evaluation cohort, exactly same original source-frozen past-only normalizer and sources. No outcome-based sample selection and no unseen model generalization claim.
evidence: Original four trained checkpoints SHA against registered LATFUSE008 original RESULTS.json, all actual weights immutable, reuse trained original source-only cohort/normalizer and source masks/time after source SHA.
method: Run 24 real pre-event source observations to event, freeze that original event-time state as independent differentiable leaf (NO learned parameter gradients); continue authentic 16/64/128/512 hourly source updates, issue the original legally known historical timestamp query. After historic event logits, construct recorded high/ordinary event BCE. Compare gradients wrt original event-time and end-of-suffix associative/fast/slow tensors; no source label or old write key in model query. The nonassoc control should have no historical-event loss dependency on associative memory at all. Report gradient norm ratio event-time/final and source cohort distribution, not architecture superiority.
interpretation: This measures local learned end-to-end loss sensitivity to event-time source STATE, not gradients into actual input encoder/write key at event and not proof that higher gradients mean true recall. Full neural model is nonlinear/FP32, finite precision proof and sidecar calibration remain open.
source_permission: Original UCI501 genuine 2014 FIT only, original 2015 exposed numeric and protected2016-17 never parsed. Check source-event label only after model historic output. No hidden optimizer, no reclassification of results.
stopping_rule: Fail closed if fewer than four original source event/control pairs, live model weights/source SHA mismatch, invalid original source math or nonfinite gradients. Publish negative/zero gradient as observed; no new fitting or retrospective cohort changes.
